Maya K: Quick check — interview run for Candidate A tomorrow 9:00–12:00 PT. I set up 3 consecutive 45m panels with 15m debriefs. Can people confirm room/Zoom ownership and who will lead the debriefs?
Samir Patel: I can take the 9:00 slot and own the debrief for panel 1. Need the Zoom link and the rubric we agreed on.
Jordan R: I’ll own panel 2 and the canary questions. @Leah T can you do panel 3 debrief?
Leah T: Yep I can do panel 3 debrief. Quick question — for the coding exercise scoring, are we weighting correctness heavier than style? Thought we decided 60/40 but wanted to confirm.
Maya K: Confirmed 60% correctness, 40% design/readability. I'll paste the short rubric snippet below. Use this for debriefs and hire/no-hire recs.
Maya K: ```
Scoring Rubric (short):
- Correctness: 0-6 (major + minor bugs)
- Design & Readability: 0-4
- Communication & Tradeoffs: 0-3
- Culture fit (team-specific): 0-2
Total: 0-15, 9+ strong, 7-8 borderline
```
Samir Patel: perfect, thanks. Zoom link? Also will there be a recording policy note for candidate?
RoomOps: Rooms booked: Conf Rm B (in-person panel 1), Quiet Huddle 3 (panel 2), Zoom-only slot for panel 3. Zoom link: https://zoom.redwood.com/j/987654321 — passcode: infer123
OpsBot: Reminder set: interview-runbook checklist sent to panelists + calendar invites with debrief block (15m) — 2h before start.
Jordan R: One more ask — can someone ping eng-oncall to ensure test infra is accessible for the live coding task? Last time it timed out for a candidate.
Maya K: Good catch. @Samir can you ping eng-infra now? If they confirm we’ll add an expedient note in the invite.
Samir Patel: Pinging infra now. If they don't respond within 30m I'll swap to local sandbox for the candidate.
Leah T: All set on my end. Will score on the rubric doc and leave concise notes in the debrief doc. @Maya please DM the debrief template link.
Maya K: Sending debrief template in DM. Thanks everyone — will post a final consolidated runflow in 30m. :thumbsup:
